errors.text: The predicted ductility trend is reversed: the target reports an increase in fracture strain from about 11.6% to 14.0% after Cr addition, whereas the hypothesis predicts reduced fracture strain and premature brittle failure.
The baseline is inverted by claiming that Cr-free HfMoTaTiZr has higher fracture strain than the Cr-containing alloy.
The specified mechanical condition is room-temperature compression, not uniaxial tensile testing.
The proposed falsification criterion treats an increase in fracture strain after Cr addition as falsifying, even though that increase is the target result.
